data.one_liner: A collection of various loading spinners and animations for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a variety of pre-built loading animations accessed through static methods on the LoadingAnimationWidget class. Each animation supports customizable sizes and color parameters.
use_when: You need ready-to-use loading spinners or progress indicators.
Your app is in a loading state or waiting for an uncertain amount of time.
avoid_when: You require complex timeline-based vector animations (use Lottie or Rive instead).
strengths: Wide variety of built-in loading animations.
Straightforward static method APIs with size and color customization.
weaknesses: Limited to loading spinners and animations provided by the package.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Lottie if you want to use complex, designer-made vector animations instead of code-drawn spinners.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_animate if you need a comprehensive extension-based animation system for custom widget transitions and effects.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Rive for interactive, state-driven vector graphics and animations.
